lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: G-good... Progress on my... Ice Castle is under way...

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: ...Body is 9-90% water... and this CLOAK DOES NOTHING!!!

lines.speaker: Oolong
lines.text: Well, maybe you shoulda packed more.

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Y-you never said we were going to the Tsurumai-Tsuburi Mountains... literally, the coldest place on Earth...

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: You just told me, "Hey, Gohan, I stole-"

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: "-found the Dragon Radar. Wanna go make a wish?"

lines.speaker: Oolong
lines.text: How about a little less whining and a little more climbing? They just found the sixth ball!

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: It kinda seems wrong that we're planning on stealing a wish...

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: which reminds me - what *are* you planning to wish for?

lines.speaker: Oolong
lines.text: Yeah, yeah, just get the lead out before they find the seventh- ...oh, oink me in the alps...

lines.speaker: Dr. Kochin
lines.text: I hope I did it right...

lines.speaker: Dr. Kochin
lines.text: Oh shit oh shit oh shit! Is that bad? Can they break??

lines.speaker: Shenron
lines.text: Hurrgh, OK, what do you assholes want this ti- ...Oh. OH! Hmm!

lines.speaker: Shenron
lines.text: I am the Eternal Dragon! State your wish and I shall grant it.

lines.speaker: Dr. Kochin
lines.text: I have scoured the planet for you for the last fifty years. With you lies my only hope...

lines.speaker: Dr. Kochin
lines.text: Eternal Dragon, I beseech you! With your bountiful, mystic power... Could you please melt the ice off my front door?

lines.speaker: Dr. Kochin
lines.text: Look, I left to get groceries fifty years ago. Bit of a trek to civilization.

lines.speaker: Dr. Kochin
lines.text: Came back, the entire lair was iced over. Went back, got some salt; pretty evidential real quick that that wasn't going to work, tried fire, melted it. That just made more ice; try and figure that out. Then I tried- errh...

lines.speaker: Dr. Kochin
lines.text: I'm sorry, is this a little unorthodox?

lines.speaker: Dr. Kochin
lines.text: I'm sorry, I'm not really used to the whole magical dragon thing. I'm an engineer by trade.

lines.speaker: Shenron
lines.text: Hey look, it's fine. But how about, just throwing it out there... I give YOU the power to melt the ice!

lines.speaker: Dr. Kochin
lines.text: But that's what I have *you* for.

lines.speaker: Shenron
lines.text: Yes, I know, but I'm trying to--

lines.speaker: Dr. Kochin
lines.text: Don't you go pawning this off on ME!

lines.speaker: Shenron
lines.text: I'm NOT, but if it happens again, then--... you know, fine. Whatever.

lines.speaker: Shenron
lines.text: Yeah, well I just put a massive hole in your ozone layer.

lines.speaker: Shenron
lines.text: What, took you fifty years to find me? Good luck figuring out how long it takes *that* to fix!

lines.speaker: Dr. Kochin
lines.text: Finally! Now, to reunite with my master and... oh, crap. Did I leave my keys at Slump's?

lines.speaker: Oolong
lines.text: All right, what the hell is this and why did my wish get wasted on it?

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: It looks like an... evil lair.

lines.speaker: Oolong
lines.text: Oh no, nope, uh uh, no way, I know how this goes you can't make me- -dammit all!

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Don't worry, Oolong! I'll save you--
Sounds of Gohan taking a beating

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: Hey Gohan... c-c-c-cold enough for ya?

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: I feel like we missed some Saibamen.

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: J-j-just watch out for the exploding ones. Don't want to pull a--

lines.speaker: Yamcha
lines.text: Hey guys! I was in the middle of training and I saw what went down- -WHY!?
Yamcha's groans and tears of defeat

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: So... wanna help me build my ice cast- -AHHHHHHHHHHHHHH

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Oolong! I think Mr. Piccolo's in trouble!

lines.speaker: Oolong
lines.text: Oh, no, I'm fine, Gohan, thanks for asking.

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Yeah well sorry, but he was screaming pretty loud and--

lines.speaker: Oolong
lines.text: When's the last time you saw a fight where someone didn't scream?

lines.speaker: Oolong
lines.text: Now... we are going to go home, and *you*... are not going to tell your mother about this little outing.

lines.speaker: Oolong
lines.text: DO NOT TELL YOUR MOTHER ABOUT THIS!!

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: OK! Fine! Why do I feel like I'm going to hear that for the rest of my life?

lines.speaker: Chi-Chi
lines.text: You're seriously not going to talk to him?

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Why? He came back safe and sound.

lines.speaker: Chi-Chi
lines.text: He was gone for three days, and refuses to tell us where he went or what he did.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Oh come on, Chi-Chi! I lived in the woods for eight years all by myself!

lines.speaker: Chi-Chi
lines.text: That's why *you're* not his role model.

lines.speaker: Chi-Chi
lines.text: And THAT, is a conversation we desperately need to have.

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: I sure hope Mr. Piccolo's doing all right...

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: Gohan! Gohan! I'm trying to reach you telepathically!

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: THEY'RE FORCING THINGS INTO MY BRAIN, GOHAN!

lines.speaker: Chi-Chi
lines.text: Gohan, what is going on with you?

lines.speaker: Chi-Chi
lines.text: Well, have you finished your homework?

lines.speaker: Chi-Chi
lines.text: Gohan, you're not on drugs, right?

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: It was just the one apple, Mom.

lines.speaker: Oolong
lines.text: This is some old bullshit! Just because I stole the Dragon Radar means I have to do all the prep work?

lines.speaker: Oolong
lines.text: Where does he even grow this stuff anyway?! Doesn't have a basement...

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: Best to not to ask too many questions. Also, have you checked the oven?

lines.speaker: Oolong
lines.text: Great! Now my entire evening is gonna be spent trying to find something to watch on Netflix!

lines.speaker: Roshi
lines.text: Those better not be my brownies, pig!

lines.speaker: Roshi
lines.text: Oh jeez, Turtle, can you get that? I cannot find my feet...

lines.speaker: Turtle
lines.text: What up! You got the money?

lines.speaker: Bioman
lines.text: Bring. Us. The. Roshi. Or. Be. Destroyed!

lines.speaker: Turtle
lines.text: How 'bout you get the hell off our island?

lines.speaker: Bioman
lines.text: There. Are. Six. Of. Biomen. And. One. Of. Turtle!

lines.speaker: Turtle
lines.text: I am nine hundred and ninety-nine years old.

lines.speaker: Roshi
lines.text: Are you the buyer? [Coughing] Cause there's gonna be a bit of a delay.

lines.speaker: Roshi
lines.text: Turns out pigs can't cook brownies.

lines.speaker: Bioman
lines.text: You. Have. Been. Forcefully. Invited. To. The. Laboratory. Of. Dr. Wheelo!

lines.speaker: Roshi
lines.text: I only need one doctor, and that's "Feelgood". Also, my GP to check my prostate every few years; it's important at my age!

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: Roshi, what the heck is going o- -wait, are those Saibamen?

lines.speaker: Bioman
lines.text: We. Are. Biomen. And. If. You. Do. Not. Comply. We. Will. Make. You!

lines.speaker: Roshi
lines.text: Ohhhhh, it is a bad time for this...

lines.speaker: Roshi
lines.text: I do not hold back when I'm toasted.

lines.speaker: Dr. Kochin
lines.text: Excellent. Exactly to be expected from the World's Strongest Fighter.

lines.speaker: Roshi
lines.text: Ah, I'm not one to brag...

lines.speaker: Dr. Kochin
lines.text: Dr. Wheelo will be humbled to have you as his honored guest... whether you like it or not!

lines.speaker: Roshi
lines.text: Are the bodies not a clear indicator of how this is gonna go down?

lines.speaker: Dr. Kochin
lines.text: Well, you see... strength is only relative when a little leverage is applied.

lines.speaker: Dr. Kochin
lines.text: Now comply... lest I have my Saiba-

lines.speaker: Dr. Kochin
lines.text: Y-Yes, whatever, nobody cares! -my creations rip her limb from limb.

lines.speaker: Roshi
lines.text: Dammit, and those some fine-ass limbs too. N'alright, I'll go!

lines.speaker: Turtle
lines.text: Alright, but if the buyer shows up I'm taking ten percent.

lines.speaker: Oolong
lines.text: Bulma and Roshi might've been kidnapped.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Oh, don't sweat it! Roshi can handle *that*.

lines.speaker: Oolong
lines.text: Yeahhh, they might have also been strong enough to take Piccolo too...!

lines.speaker: Oolong
lines.text: Oh, they said they were looking for the World's Strongest Fighter.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: There's been a terrible mistake. I gotta fix this!

lines.speaker: Dr. Kochin
lines.text: There he is: Your new body!

lines.speaker: Dr. Wheelo
lines.text: And the World's Oldest. Again, Kochin, why not just give me the woman?

lines.speaker: Dr. Kochin
lines.text: I told you, you can't have a *woman's* body! They're not NEARLY strong enough!

lines.speaker: Dr. Wheelo
lines.text: Sexism aside, I'm really not that picky.

lines.speaker: Dr. Kochin
lines.text: Also, she doesn't have a penis.

lines.speaker: Dr. Wheelo
lines.text: ...So you want to give me the old man?

lines.speaker: Dr. Kochin
lines.text: Listen, you just need a demonstration.

lines.speaker: Roshi
lines.text: Oh, come on! This ain't your first kidnappin'.

lines.speaker: Dr. Wheelo
lines.text: Kochin... what did you do to my creations!?

lines.speaker: Dr. Kochin
lines.text: I made a few alterations this morning.

lines.speaker: Dr. Kochin
lines.text: Fighting someone on the trademark for that last name though.

lines.speaker: Dr. Wheelo
lines.text: They were supposed to be cute, and cuddly, and aid the elderly!

lines.speaker: Dr. Kochin
lines.text: Now they're *cruel*, and *vicious*, and *fight* the elderly! Speaking of which...

lines.speaker: Roshi
lines.text: Ah man, and I'm comin' down.

lines.speaker: Dr. Kochin
lines.text: Fiddlesticks. I could have sworn he was the strongest fighter in the world!

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: Roshi's not even in the top five anymore. As in: I got at least five friends, all stronger than he is.

lines.speaker: Dr. Wheelo
lines.text: My name is Dr. Wheelo. Good to meet you!

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: Wait, Dr. Jonathan Wheelo? The famous biologist and cancer researcher!?

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: Your breakthroughs changed the entire landscape of the field!

lines.speaker: Dr. Wheelo
lines.text: Oh, thank you! Thank you. Can I have your body?

lines.speaker: Dr. Wheelo
lines.text: Oh, I'm so sorry! Not sexually. I-I-I mean your actual, physical body.

lines.speaker: Dr. Wheelo
lines.text: Oh, come on, it's been 50 years~!

lines.speaker: Dr. Wheelo
lines.text: I suddenly got sick one day - lung cancer, ironically; and THAT one decides to put me in stasis.

lines.speaker: Dr. Wheelo
lines.text: Next thing I know, he's gone - to get groceries - for 50 years, which is just my father all over again.

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: OK, well, I'm sorry and all but there's no way I'd agree to that.

lines.speaker: Dr. Kochin
lines.text: Oh, your grey matter seems to have absorbed a LITTLE bit of the Embalming Fluid that you're stored in.

lines.speaker: Dr. Wheelo
lines.text: But a Golden Retriever's brain is small!

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: No; like, the SIZE of a Golden Retriever.

lines.speaker: Dr. Wheelo
lines.text: I can't fit in a body like THIS!

lines.speaker: Dr. Kochin
lines.text: Don't worry about it! Sometimes, brain surgery is a little more 'art' than science.

lines.speaker: Dr. Kochin
lines.text: I might be thinking of baking.

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: Well, "Pinky", you picked the wrong guy anyway. You want Son Goku.

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: To be fair, there's probably a vacancy, but you have to get him here first, and good luck kidnapping--

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Helloooo... my name is Son Goku. Is anyone home?

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: If you're looking for the World's Strongest Fighter, I'm here.

lines.speaker: Dr. Kochin
lines.text: Yes, yes, Son Goku! Please, if you would, join us!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: It's actually colder!!! How is it colder!?

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Oh, cool, he's got a ball pit!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Oh, no, he's got a ball pit...

lines.speaker: Dr. Kochin
lines.text: Oh, the Deathspheres! Quite ingenious, no?

lines.speaker: Dr. Wheelo
lines.text: No! Why do we have them?!

lines.speaker: Dr. Kochin
lines.text: Well, if the Red Ribbon Army hadn't suddenly up and disappeared, they'd have made us a mint!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: That was easily the second-worst ball pit I've ever been in.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Oh no oh God ew ew eww it's moist... why is it moist?!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: OK... get it together... Just gotta go in there, and do it.

lines.speaker: Dr. Kochin
lines.text: Good, good! He's already dispatched of one of the Bio-Warriors!

lines.speaker: Dr. Wheelo
lines.text: Blub-Blub... he was made for hugs...

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: I swear, I'mma deck the heck out of the next guy I see...

lines.speaker: Freezer
lines.text: Zaps, get in here, I-I need a sec.

lines.speaker: Freezer
lines.text: Then Electrocutionate™ him! I don't give a f**k!

lines.speaker: Dr. Kochin
lines.text: Of course they can! They're completely sentient...

lines.speaker: Dr. Kochin
lines.text: ...with all their own wants and needs, and a crippling fear of death!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Wait, "Freezer"? Why does that sound familiar- -oooh God it's like the worst part of getting into a pool TIMES 1000!!!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Thank goodness, Piccolo's here-! -oh, hey son.

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Hold tight Dad, we've got you!

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: And the Krilldog's in the houuuu- *Screaming*

lines.speaker: Dr. Kochin
lines.text: Man, your new body is gonna be wicked! Completely destroyed the Bio-Warriors.

lines.speaker: Dr. Wheelo
lines.text: Kochin... why didn't you give me one of THEIR bodies?

lines.speaker: Dr. Kochin
lines.text: ...I guess you're right... See, this is why YOU'RE the brains.

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Frost bite... so-o-o much frost bite...!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Don't worry Krillin, the cold never killed anyone!

lines.speaker: Dr. Wheelo
lines.text: Why did you turn out the lights?

lines.speaker: Dr. Kochin
lines.text: To give us an air of menace!

lines.speaker: Dr. Wheelo
lines.text: Why would do we need menace?

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Wow... this place sure is menacing.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Don't worry, Bulma! I'll get you out of- -hehyehyehyehyehyehyeh!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Ugh... I'm gonna have nerd damage after today.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Heyy! Why didn't you warn me?!

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: I didn't know what would happen! I haven't tried to break out!

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: (Gasp) Oh, my goodness! Is that a brain?!

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Why is it the size of a Greyhound?

lines.speaker: Dr. Kochin
lines.text: This is the magnificent Dr. Wheelo, and we'd like to welcome you to our evil lair!

lines.speaker: Dr. Wheelo
lines.text: This is neither a lair, nor is it evil! This is a laboratory - for science!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: I don't care what kind of science you're cooking up! I'm here for two things:

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: To rescue my friends, and correct a mistake!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: I, am Son Goku! And I, am the World's Strongest!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Good! Then if you don't mind, I'mma just grab my friends and be on my wa- -AAAAAAAAUUUUUUGGGGHHHH

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Pride cometh before the fall, eh, Dad?

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Come on, Gohan! It's two against- -huh. Three! Three against one. Haha!

lines.speaker: Dr. Wheelo
lines.text: Wait, how long have we had *him*?

lines.speaker: Dr. Wheelo
lines.text: Well, just give me his body!!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Yo, I broke out of the thingy. Oh! Hey, Piccolo!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Wow, your eyes are *red*. You been hanging around Master Roshi?

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Don't you dare hit my son!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Unless you're training right now. In which case; Gohan, get back up.

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Dad, I think Dr. Wheelo's controlling him!

lines.speaker: Dr. Wheelo
lines.text: But I am a BRAIN in a jar!

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Stop this! You're men of science! How could you commit such atrocities?

lines.speaker: Dr. Kochin
lines.text: Excuse you, MUSTARD GAS would like a word.

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Uh, excuse you, solar energy has something to say.

lines.speaker: Dr. Kochin
lines.text: Excuse YOU, anthrax has an opinion on that.

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Excuse YOU, penicillin would like to chime in!

lines.speaker: Dr. Kochin
lines.text: You're right. He's incredibly strong! In fact--

lines.speaker: Dr. Kochin
lines.text: Insolent boy! He's in for such a caning--

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Not so tough without your cane, huh, old man?
Krillin is at shot point-blank range... ...to no effect

lines.speaker: Roshi
lines.text: And that's for ruinin' my Sunday.

lines.speaker: Dr. Wheelo
lines.text: 50 years, I was alone. And when I am finally saved from that loneliness, all I find is horror!

lines.speaker: Dr. Wheelo
lines.text: In this form, I am *powerless*; doomed to witness these atrocities!

lines.speaker: Dr. Wheelo
lines.text: HOW LONG HAVE I HAD THIS?!?!?

lines.speaker: Dr. Kochin
lines.text: Wait, you SERIOUSLY never noticed the exo body I left for you? Did you think I'd literally just leave you in a jar?

lines.speaker: Dr. Kochin
lines.text: What kind of MONSTER do you think I a-? -FAIR ENOUUUUUUUGH...!!!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: See? Now you got a body!

lines.speaker: Dr. Wheelo
lines.text: THIS is NOT a body! This can't taste, or smell, or touch!

lines.speaker: Dr. Wheelo
lines.text: I am a brain, TRAPPED in an exoskeleton!

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: Well, when you think about it, aren't we all just- -BUUR-CK!

lines.speaker: Roshi
lines.text: A Kame and a Hame and a Send-Him-Home-To-Mommy!

lines.speaker: Roshi
lines.text: KRILLIN, YOU BETTER NOT HAVE HELD BACK!

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Oh, come on! We BOTH know it was Goku- -WHAA!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: All right, everyone! Stand back! Imma Kaiō-ken him!

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: WOW, that was... quicker than expected...

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Naw... he's alive up there! Plotting like the evil scientist he is...!

lines.speaker: Dr. Wheelo
lines.text: Look at this planet... oh, so beautiful... I'll never see it with my own eyes again...

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Someone needs to kill him! And by someone... I mean the Earth!

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Hey, Dr. Wheelo, I... wait, are you crying?

lines.speaker: Dr. Wheelo
lines.text: I physically can't, but I'm just so SA-HA-HA-HAAD...!

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: You're... not really evil at all, are you?

lines.speaker: Dr. Wheelo
lines.text: No... I just want a BODY... Fifty years ALONE and TRAPPED...

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: All right! Ready to kill him!

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Dad, no, we worked it out! He's not evil!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Oh! ...Well, I can't just turn this off! Maybe if I just set it down...

lines.speaker: Shenron
lines.text: I am the Eternal Dragon. State your- -... (Sigh), OK, who died?

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Actually, nobody! In fact, we want you to create a whole NEW body!

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: We want you to make a human body, and put that brain inside of it!

lines.speaker: Shenron
lines.text: Huh...! Well, at least it's better than that last wish. Who summons the Eternal Dragon to melt some ICE?!

lines.speaker: Dr. Wheelo
lines.text: Now I can live a normal life again...
♫ Their lair is girt by ice ♫
♫ They're Kochin and a Brain, Brain, Brain, Brain ♫
♫ By the ending of this spiel ♫
♫ One of them may just die ♫
♫ They're Kochin and a Brain, Brain, Brain, Brain ♫

lines.speaker: Masakox
lines.text: Two million subscribers! Two million! Thank you so much for getting us to this marvelous milestone!

lines.speaker: Masakox
lines.text: Without you, we would be nothing like we are now. Thank you. Here's to you, everyone. You truly are The World's Strongest.

lines.speaker: Masakox
lines.text: So what did you think of the movie?

lines.speaker: Masakox
lines.text: If you liked it, be sure to like it and subscribe to keep up with the latest content from DBZA, as well as catching up on any movies and episodes you might have missed!

lines.speaker: Masakox
lines.text: Speaking of episodes, we also have some additional content for you over on TFS Gaming! Goku's gonna show you what happens when Chi-Chi isn't around,

lines.speaker: Masakox
lines.text: as he shows you the "hot" new sensation from the makers of HuniePop, HunieCam Studio, right here on the left! Where did he get that game from? Hmm...

lines.speaker: Masakox
lines.text: We recently dropped our first-ever album from our newest show, Final Fantasy VII: Machinabridged! If you wish to sample some of the tracks from season one's Midgar Mix,

lines.speaker: Masakox
lines.text: be sure to click here on the right, where you can get download links from iTunes, Google Play, Spotify, Amazon, and Loudr!

lines.speaker: Masakox
lines.text: Or just kick back and listen to the tunes! We've got all our bases covered!

lines.speaker: Masakox
lines.text: Not only that, but we also have a new, special-edition Star Wars X Dragon Ball shirt with the adorable 'droid, BB-8! Or, as we like to call him, DB-8!

lines.speaker: Masakox
lines.text: You can find this, as well as our other shirts at sharkrobot.com/team-four-star! Go do that!

lines.speaker: Masakox
lines.text: Oh, but before you do that, be sure to check out my channel, MasakoX Stream, where you can see what I get up to! Including reading bad DBZ fanfiction, as well as other franchises and series! Trust me, it's an absolute hoot.

lines.speaker: Masakox
lines.text: Anyway, guys, thanks for tuning in and sticking with us for almost eight years! Until next time, guys! Catch you later!

segments.title: Melt the Ice Off My Front Door
segments.quote: Eternal Dragon, I beseech you! With your bountiful, mystic power... Could you please melt the ice off my front door?

segments.title: Shenron, Out
segments.quote: I just put a massive hole in your ozone layer. ... Shenron, out. / No! My Schwein-Staffel!

segments.title: Don't Want to Pull a "That"
segments.quote: Just watch out for the exploding ones. Don't want to pull a-- / -WHY!? / "That". Don't want to pull a "that".

segments.title: GOHAN!! MY VEINS!!!
segments.quote: THEY'RE FORCING THINGS INTO MY BRAIN, GOHAN! GOHAN!! MY VEEEIIIIINS!!!!!!!!!!!!!

segments.title: One. Of. Turtle!
segments.quote: There. Are. Six. Of. Biomen. And. One. Of. Turtle! / I am nine hundred and ninety-nine years old. I don't give a f**k!

segments.title: With the Old Man's Penis
segments.quote: Also, she doesn't have a penis. / ...So you want to give me the old man? / Yes. / With the old man's penis.

segments.title: Introducing... Freezer!
segments.quote: Introducing... Electrocutioner™! Bouncy Butcher™! and... Freezer! / Fighting someone on the trademark for that last name though.

segments.title: The Size of a Golden Retriever
segments.quote: I'd say... a Golden Retriever. / But a Golden Retriever's brain is small! / No; like, the SIZE of a Golden Retriever.

segments.title: The Second-Worst Ball Pit
segments.quote: Oh, cool, he's got a ball pit! ... Oh, no, he's got a ball pit... / That was easily the second-worst ball pit I've ever been in.

segments.title: Science-Off
